newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Oil World sees '96/97 veg oil stocks down sharply.
newsitem.headline: Oil World sees '96/97 veg oil stocks down sharply.

text.p: The editor of market publication Oil World said on Thursday he expected world stocks of vegetable oils to fall by 1.2-1.3 million tonnes in 1996/97 (Oct/Sept), over the previous season, to around 10.8-10.9 million tonnes.
Thomas Mielke said at an Edible Oils Markets conference in Singapore that soybean oil and palm oil prices will benefit from the fall in stocks.
"We see little potential for an increase in stocks," he said, adding the estimate on oil stocks will be released this week in Oil World's annual report.
He said strong demand and stagnant production will lead to a drawdown in stocks and underpin a resurgence in prices of soybean oil and palm oil.
"The oils and fats markets is very strong. It is my opinion that current oil prices do not reflect this. The potential for a considerable increase in the price of oils and fats is there."
